raw: [name="Doctor"]The burden I bear is greater than the future of the Sarkaz. If I must destroy some things to create a ladder I hope for...
speaker: Doctor
content: The burden I bear is greater than the future of the Sarkaz. If I must destroy some things to create a ladder I hope for...

raw: [name="Doctor"]I will do it. It's all I can do.
speaker: Doctor
content: I will do it. It's all I can do.

raw: [name="Doctor"]I've already hesitated for far too long.
speaker: Doctor
content: I've already hesitated for far too long.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Destroy some things, to create a ladder...
speaker: Theresis
content: Destroy some things, to create a ladder...

speaker: Theresis
content: You speak lightly of sacrifice.

speaker: Doctor
content: Nothing light here, Theresis.

raw: [name="Doctor"]Believe me when I say, you couldn't even conceive of what I've been through.
speaker: Doctor
content: Believe me when I say, you couldn't even conceive of what I've been through.

raw: [name="Theresis"]And where do I see your sincerity for our cooperation?
speaker: Theresis
content: And where do I see your sincerity for our cooperation?

raw: [name="Doctor"]Is the Shard not enough for you? Otherwise, even with the help of the Confessarii, you—
speaker: Doctor
content: Is the Shard not enough for you? Otherwise, even with the help of the Confessarii, you—

raw: [name="Theresis"]It is not. It is far from enough, evil spirit.
speaker: Theresis
content: It is not. It is far from enough, evil spirit.

raw: [name="Theresis"]It is only enough to spare your life. Only enough to stop me, leader of the Military Commission, from killing a fated foe here and now.
speaker: Theresis
content: It is only enough to spare your life. Only enough to stop me, leader of the Military Commission, from killing a fated foe here and now.

raw: [name="Theresis"]I require an even more direct means to advance this war to the next stage.
speaker: Theresis
content: I require an even more direct means to advance this war to the next stage.

raw: [name="Theresis"]If you wish for the Babel members to be spared, then so be it.
speaker: Theresis
content: If you wish for the Babel members to be spared, then so be it.

raw: [name="Theresis"]The Military Commission promises you that as long as Babel concedes defeat and departs Kazdel, we will not exterminate those who desert or surrender.
speaker: Theresis
content: The Military Commission promises you that as long as Babel concedes defeat and departs Kazdel, we will not exterminate those who desert or surrender.

raw: [name="Theresis"]But you know what you must do in return.
speaker: Theresis
content: But you know what you must do in return.

speaker: Doctor
content: No... You can't...

raw: [name="Theresis"]Who would have thought that the evil spirit, who so roused the interest of the Nachzehrer King, would be such a coward?
speaker: Theresis
content: Who would have thought that the evil spirit, who so roused the interest of the Nachzehrer King, would be such a coward?

raw: [name="Theresis"]You can't both let Theresa live and allow the Babel members to leave safely; it's a total contradiction.
speaker: Theresis
content: You can't both let Theresa live and allow the Babel members to leave safely; it's a total contradiction.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Only with the destruction of Babel and the complete eradication of its members can Theresa leave for Londinium with me.
speaker: Theresis
content: Only with the destruction of Babel and the complete eradication of its members can Theresa leave for Londinium with me.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Otherwise, it would merely be a case of the Military Commission quashing and dispersing yet another group of civilians, migrants, and pacifists.
speaker: Theresis
content: Otherwise, it would merely be a case of the Military Commission quashing and dispersing yet another group of civilians, migrants, and pacifists.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Even without my order, such things will happen naturally.
speaker: Theresis
content: Even without my order, such things will happen naturally.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Perhaps you believe that Theresa would be willing to step back and watch it before her eyes? She will not. And so she will resist.
speaker: Theresis
content: Perhaps you believe that Theresa would be willing to step back and watch it before her eyes? She will not. And so she will resist.

raw: [name="Theresis"]You know what I ask of you. If you truly wish to save the many who stand by your side, make them willingly admit defeat and surrender to me...
speaker: Theresis
content: You know what I ask of you. If you truly wish to save the many who stand by your side, make them willingly admit defeat and surrender to me...

speaker: Theresis
content: Then slay their king.

raw: [name="Theresis"]And then, I will allow Babel to leave. As it collapses, it will no longer be considered a Sarkaz endeavor, and it will grow weak, drifting to the edges of civilization.
speaker: Theresis
content: And then, I will allow Babel to leave. As it collapses, it will no longer be considered a Sarkaz endeavor, and it will grow weak, drifting to the edges of civilization.

raw: [name="Theresis"]'Destroy some things to create a ladder', {@nickname}.
speaker: Theresis
content: 'Destroy some things to create a ladder', {@nickname}.

raw: [name="Theresis"]You're right. There is nothing light about this.
speaker: Theresis
content: You're right. There is nothing light about this.

raw: [name="Doctor"]In your opinion, what is the meaning behind this civil war? What meaning would her death hold?
speaker: Doctor
content: In your opinion, what is the meaning behind this civil war? What meaning would her death hold?

raw: [name="Theresis"]Reclaiming our lands, rebuilding our homes, ending discrimination, and revitalizing our race. You will have heard these platitudes many times.
speaker: Theresis
content: Reclaiming our lands, rebuilding our homes, ending discrimination, and revitalizing our race. You will have heard these platitudes many times.

raw: [name="Theresis"]They are too complex, and yet too simple.
speaker: Theresis
content: They are too complex, and yet too simple.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Merely a small and pitiful species trying to grasp their fate.
speaker: Theresis
content: Merely a small and pitiful species trying to grasp their fate.

speaker: Doctor
content: I see.

raw: [name="Doctor"]In that case, I will tip the scales of destiny.
speaker: Doctor
content: In that case, I will tip the scales of destiny.

raw: [name="Doctor"]Destroy Babel, divide them, weaken them. Allow them to return to their former lives, so that they can know a moment of peace in the final century.
speaker: Doctor
content: Destroy Babel, divide them, weaken them. Allow them to return to their former lives, so that they can know a moment of peace in the final century.

raw: [name="Doctor"]That way... we don't have to kill Theresa. Or at the very least, we can minimize the loss of life.
speaker: Doctor
content: That way... we don't have to kill Theresa. Or at the very least, we can minimize the loss of life.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Fretting over violence serves only to stifle you. You understand the Sarkaz better than most, but perhaps still not well enough.
speaker: Theresis
content: Fretting over violence serves only to stifle you. You understand the Sarkaz better than most, but perhaps still not well enough.

speaker: Theresis
content: I have a question myself, Dr. {@nickname}.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Evil spirit of a bygone age, you who call yourself a giant, a god, a supreme creator, one who can dictate the fate of the Sarkaz. Are you the only one of your kind?
speaker: Theresis
content: Evil spirit of a bygone age, you who call yourself a giant, a god, a supreme creator, one who can dictate the fate of the Sarkaz. Are you the only one of your kind?

speaker: Doctor
content: ...I am.

raw: [name="Theresis"]That is good to know. Go, now, without guilt, and do what you have decided to do.
speaker: Theresis
content: That is good to know. Go, now, without guilt, and do what you have decided to do.

raw: [name="Theresis"]If you worry there will be no one to tear you down from your lofty heights, or judge your sins. Don't. I will do it, evil spirit.
speaker: Theresis
content: If you worry there will be no one to tear you down from your lofty heights, or judge your sins. Don't. I will do it, evil spirit.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Until there are none left to toy with our fate.
speaker: Theresis
content: Until there are none left to toy with our fate.

raw: The Doctor listens to the splashing of the puddles behind, the sound of footsteps fading into the distance.
content: The Doctor listens to the splashing of the puddles behind, the sound of footsteps fading into the distance.

raw: Theresis is gone, wishing to stay not a moment longer.
content: Theresis is gone, wishing to stay not a moment longer.

raw: Pale sunlight begins to seep through the gaps between the statues.
content: Pale sunlight begins to seep through the gaps between the statues.

raw: The Doctor cannot feel the slightest bit of warmth from it.
content: The Doctor cannot feel the slightest bit of warmth from it.

raw: The heroes continue to gaze into the distance. They do not look beneath their feet.
content: The heroes continue to gaze into the distance. They do not look beneath their feet.

raw: There stands a figure who does not leave for a long, long time.
content: There stands a figure who does not leave for a long, long time.
